usage: deskops add repository [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                              [--name NAME] [--path PATH] [--status STATUS]
                              [--description DESCRIPTION]
                              [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]]

Create a local repository artifact doc; use 'deskops repo register' for canonical ecosystem registration.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the repository payload from a YAML file.
  --name NAME           Short human-readable name of the repository.
  --path PATH           Relative path to the repository root from the ecosystem root.
  --status STATUS       Current status of the repository (e.g., active, maintenance, archived).
  --description DESCRIPTION
                        Markdown description of the repository's purpose and scope.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Semantic tags for categorization (e.g., type:tool, layer:infra).

Example:
  deskops add repository --root . --title "Example"
